hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Cross-asset stress, elevated expected shortfalls, and generally weak or marginal alpha warrant a defensive overlay. BTC is the most credible signal due to superior liquidity and institutional support, but its conviction remains modest. ETH and SOL are fragile because of negative alpha, elevated beta/volatility, and weaker liquidity. BCH, DOGE, and LTC have flat council directions with negative alpha and weak institutional/liquidity scores. ETC is critically fragile: its zero price and zero risk/liquidity fields indicate unusable or invalid data; do not rely on its long signal.
